name: Bluey x Crossy Road Castle
summary:
Explore "Bluey's House", a new tower with brand new Bluey themed levels. Complete challenges to unlock your favourite Bluey characters from the show. Dress them up in silly hats from the show like Bingo’s husband hat and the Queen’s Crown. Pop balloons, avoid gnomes, ride water slides - play the obstacle course challenges and don't get out.

This Bluey crossover is exclusive to the Apple Arcade version of Crossy Road Castle.
